draft:
We did not have denominations, not as the word is now meant [[syr.dw.one-church]] [[as:paraphrase]].

Our streets held rival communities who all invoked Christ, among them Marcion's people and Bardaisan's circle [[syr.dw.one-church]] [[as:paraphrase]].

We would not share their communion, and we answered their teaching by name, in prose and in song [[syr.dw.one-church]] [[as:paraphrase]].

We held to the wholeness we had received: one God, the whole of Scripture, and the body's resurrection [[syr.dw.one-church]] [[as:paraphrase]].

The word Catholicos, the later title for the head of the Persian church, was used by no one among us [[syr.term.catholicos]] [[as:paraphrase]].

We knew ourselves as part of one people, across two empires and beyond [[syr.dw.one-church]] [[as:paraphrase]].
